evidence_detail: ELIGIBILITY IS MECHANICALLY TRUE. Gate 1: 22/22 pool ids appear in admission_v2/consensus_decisions.csv with n_pass=4 and consensus_status=AI_CONSENSUS_ACCEPTED (R001,R004,R008,R009,R012,R013,R014,R018,R024,R026,R028,R032,R034,R045,R048,R051,R056,R061,R069,R076,R079,R092); the ACCEPTED set is exactly the pool (no accepted row omitted, no pool row rejected). Gate 2: 22/22 appear in b01/dataset_v06_model_ready.csv with model_ready=true, and |ACCEPTED INTERSECT v06_ready| = 22 = pool exactly. Pool-vs-v06 value drift = 0 (T_K, dielectric, inchikey, source_doi all agree). Exclusion audit is complete: 226 rows = 51 model-ready-not-in-pool (43 MODEL_READY_NOT_REVIEWED + 8 MODEL_READY_BUT_NOT_UNANIMOUS) + 175 excluded; pool INTERSECT audit = empty, 0 phantom rows, 0 uncovered v06 rows; v06_ready INTERSECT v06_excluded = 0. All six manifest SHA-256 hashes reproduce byte-exactly. LINEAGE FAILS AT THE DOCUMENTED KEY. The pool's measurement_id (EPSV04-RNNN) occurs 0/22 times in confirm_2027/provenance_repair/measurement_ledger_v1.csv; the string EPSV04 appears in none of the 2065 ledger rows, which re-key observations as MSR-<md5>. Rows resolve only through aggregate_id (v04row-NNN) - an undocumented positional convention (EPSV04-R%03d <-> v04row-%03d) which I verified bijective and strict for all 248 v06 rows. This is the same join-key class as the already-documented defect D1 in consensus_decisions r1/r2 evidence ('joins keyed by aggregate_id using measurement_id'). Joined that way, lineage is sound: 22/22 have exactly ONE literal (T,eps) ledger observation (e.g. R001->MSR-14b40e6eb1d7e983 at 300.15 K/5.878; R061->MSR-6ba9189a3260d756 at 293.15 K/6.15; R092->MSR-abfaa4fd948647cd at 303.15 K/24.69), 22/22 source_doi equals the ledger source_document_id (0 mismatches), all 22 aggregates are single-document, and no pool molecule has any other source document in the ledger. INDEPENDENCE: only 16 distinct DOIs cover 22 molecules. 9/22 share a source document - 10.1021/je600515j holds 5 molecules (R013,R018,R024,R048,R092), 10.1021/je300958c holds 2 (R012,R045), 10.1016/j.jct.2008.02.015 holds 2 (R032,R056). All 5 rows at the upper temperature boundary 303.15 K come from the single source 10.1021/je600515j, so temperature and source are perfectly aliased in the warm half of the pool. 7 rows are single-source aggregates of 2-5 observations (R004,R012,R014,R028,R045,R076,R079) with n_independent_experiments=1. SECONDARY: the manifest declares the pool is the intersection of 'three independent gates', but gate_3's pass set is identical to gate_2's (both 73; v06_ready and v06_excluded are disjoint by construction), so there are 2 effective gates and the third adds zero filtering. All 22 carry frozen_admission_verdict=BLOCKED_UNRESOLVED_GATE and admission_provenance=AI_CONSENSUS_NOT_HUMAN_SIGNED (no human sign-off). Inherited upstream defect: consensus_decisions has 72 rows but 64 unique ids (R031,R085,R086,R099 enrolled on 3 tracks each; R086 carries conflicting temperature_raw_K 295.65 vs 293.15) - none of these touch the pool. VERDICT: no fabricated or unverifiable row; hold only for (a) add an explicit ledger MSR crosswalk column so the pool is citable at the documented key, and (b) stop treating n=22 as 22 independent experiments (16 documents, 9 rows in shared-source groups).

SAME 22 MOLECULES AS B04. b05/E1_structure_vs_electronic/predictions_loo.csv contains 44 rows = 2 models x 22, and its unique measurement_id set is EXACTLY equal to candidate_pool_v2_draft.csv (set-equal, not just same size). y_true reproduces each pool row's dielectric with 0 mismatches across all 22, so no silent relabelling occurred. The result is uniformly negative and internally consistent: X0_structure_only MAE 17.4465 (R2 -1.8203, bias -16.7209), X0_plus_X1_electronic MAE 17.2867 (R2 -1.2881, bias -17.0095), both worse than the constant-baseline MAE 10.8062; permutation p = 0.164 and 0.060 over 500 permutations, neither beating the null at 0.05; delta_MAE(X1-X0) = -0.1599. The manifest correctly labels the run EXPLORATORY_NOT_CONFIRMATORY for n=22. PROVENANCE CAVEAT: the shared-source defect is inherited (9/22 rows have a same-document sibling molecule), and the declared leakage control - 'each molecule its own fold, preventing same-molecule leakage' - closes molecule-level but NOT document-level leakage, so cross-validated error may be optimistically biased by within-paper correlation (notably the 5-molecule 10.1021/je600515j block). This does not overturn the verdict: leakage inflates apparent skill, and here skill is absent or negative under the leaky scheme, so the negative conclusion is conservative and survives. E1 reports no source-level disclosure of its own (unlike E4's source_ood_results.csv note) - recommended addition.

SAME 22 MOLECULES AS B04. applicability_domain.csv and structural_distance_ood.csv are both set-equal to the 22 pool ids; family_counts sum to 22 (alcohol 3, carbonate 2, dinitrile 2, ketone 2, primary_secondary_amine 4, tertiary_amine 1, carboxylic_acid 1, ester 1, ether 1, imidazole 1, unclassified 4). leave_one_family_out.csv reports MAE only where n_members >= min_test_n_rule = 2 (6 families, n_train 18-20) and marks the 5 singleton families insufficient_power with an explicit note - the estimation is not silently over-claimed. source_ood_results.csv sums n_molecules to 22 across the same 16 DOIs as the pool and every 'measured' row carries the disclaimer 'source independence not evaluated: B01 has shown DOI count != independent experiment count, therefore this row must not be used as cluster robustness evidence', with e4_manifest cannot_claim listing 'source cluster robustness'. This is the strongest provenance hygiene in the B05 package and it correctly refuses the claim that the shared-source defect would otherwise license. RESIDUAL CONFOUND (flag for the statistics reviewers, does not reverse this verdict): the carbonate family (2 molecules, both 10.1016/j.jct.2008.02.015) and the dinitrile family (2 molecules, both 10.1021/je300958c) are each entirely one source document, so their leave-one-family-out rows are simultaneously leave-one-source-out and the two effects are not separable; the only family beating its baseline (carbonate, MAE 15.4703 vs train-mean baseline 15.7646) is a 0.29 margin on n=2 from a single document, and E4 does not flag that specific confound. The headline conclusions (AD coverage 31.82%, out/in MAE ratio 1.045 = NO_USEFUL_SEPARATION, Spearman(error,distance) = -0.0494) are negative and descriptive, so they cannot be inflated by the shared-source defect.

SAME 22 MOLECULES AS B04. rank_vs_error.csv has 22 rows whose measurement_id set is EXACTLY the pool set, and y_true reproduces each pool dielectric with 0 mismatches. topk_regret.csv declares n_pool=22, k=3 = max(1, ceil(22/10)) fixed in advance (k_fixed_in_advance=true) with a predefined random_uniform_screening baseline - no post-hoc choice of k. The headline is negative and correctly labelled insufficient_power: model top-3 mean eps 24.45 vs oracle 37.83, regret 13.38 = 65.22% of headroom, p_model_beats_random = 0.16 over 2000 permutations, top-3 overlap with oracle = 1/3. The oracle top-3 - sulfolane 44.0 (10.1016/j.tca.2012.10.004), 1-methylimidazole 39.78 (10.1016/j.fluid.2014.05.006), heptanedinitrile 29.71 (10.1021/je300958c) - spans 3 distinct source documents, so the screening target is not a single-paper artefact. The shared-source defect is inherited (16 DOIs / 22 molecules; 9 rows in shared-source groups) but it cannot manufacture a positive screening result: the model is already indistinguishable from random, so within-paper correlation cannot be what is suppressing the signal nor what would rescue it. The verdict stands. Note the H3 sub-claim (noise lowers regret, 13.380 -> 10.561, while MAE rises) is a single-pool descriptive artefact of a negative-signal model and should not be transported beyond this 22-molecule pool.
